title: Scorched Scamorza Tagine
description: A spicy, smoky twist on traditional North African dish, featuring scamorza cheese and a blend of Middle Eastern spices.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together scamorza cheese, tagine spice blend, and a pinch of salt.
3. Arrange the scamorza mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
4. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the scamorza is melted and golden brown.
5. Meanwhile, mix together chopped coriander leaves and pitted olives in a bowl.
6. Once the scamorza is done, let it cool for a minute or two.
7. Spoon the scamorza mixture onto a serving platter or individual plates.
8. Top with the mixed coriander and olive mixture.
9. Drizzle with bitter orange marmalade, if using.
